report.summary: Detected 2 drift findings (2 review recommended): unmodeled Redis session storage surface and an undeclared go-redis third-party dependency.

findings.title: Unmodeled third-party dependency github.com/redis/go-redis/v9

evidence.note: github.com/redis/go-redis/v9 v9.7.0 is added as a direct dependency without a corresponding third-party dependency assertion in app.tm.hcl.

relevance.justification: A new external client library is introduced for session caching, but the threat model does not list it among third-party dependencies.

findings.agent_prompt: Update app.tm.hcl: add a third_party_dependency block for 'redis' (github.com/redis/go-redis/v9) added in go.mod:6, documenting its role and uptime dependency for the login service session cache.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a third_party_dependency block for Redis / go-redis in app.tm.hcl.

findings.title: Unmodeled Redis session caching storage and retrieval path

evidence.note: NewCache initializes a new Redis client connecting to an external Redis instance.
Put stores Restricted session tokens in Redis via client.Set.
Get fetches session tokens from Redis via client.Get to resolve user sessions.

relevance.justification: Restricted session tokens are now persisted and resolved over a network cache (Redis), introducing an attack surface not captured by existing model threats.

findings.agent_prompt: Update app.tm.hcl: document threats and security controls covering the Redis session cache introduced in internal/session/cache.go, specifically addressing network transport security, cache access controls, and storage protection for Restricted session tokens.
findings.suggested_fix: Add threats and controls in app.tm.hcl for session token caching and transmission to Redis.
